YOUR FIRST AERIAL Hold jump, tilt the nose up with S, then boost. Use Q / E to land wheels down.

Controller: RT/LT drive, left stick steer/pitch, A jump, B boost, X powerslide, Y ball cam, LB/RB air roll, Start pause. Desktop keyboard or gamepad required; touch driving is not included.

 ORIGINAL GAME. RESEARCHED MECHANICS.

BUILT FOR THE BROWSER.

Boost Circuit is an independent car-soccer recreation inspired by Rocket League. It uses original game code, your supplied Champions Field stadium and Fennec model with procedural wheel animation, and Three.js rendering on your device.

Arena measurements, boost behavior and jump references come from RLGym and the RLBot community. Psyonix’s gameplay guides informed the camera, training and match flow. Contact response, wall adhesion, bots and handling are approximations.

This is a local single-player game with bots, free play and training. Online multiplayer, Rocket League accounts and exact proprietary physics are not included.

Fennec model by Jako, supplied by you and adapted under CC BY 4.0. Wheel pivots, materials and browser optimization have been added.

Champions Field stadium by Prabhu Ram / virtualmakes, adapted from your supplied model under CC BY 4.0. Architecture and banners are retained; materials are adapted and the inner pitch uses calibrated game surfaces. Original stadium model ↗
